create_SSLTensorboardHook: create an SSLTensorboardHook instance with a SummaryWriter to log training metrics, parameters, and gradients to TensorBoard
configure_activation_statistics_logging: configure activation statistics logging by setting log_activation_statistics frequency in SSLTensorboardHook to monitor and log activation mean and spread
log_model_parameters_gradients: log model parameters and gradients as histograms to TensorBoard at configurable iteration intervals during training
monitor_gpu_memory_speed_metrics: monitor and log GPU memory usage, batch processing time, images per second, and ETA to TensorBoard during training iterations
log_phase_end_metrics: log training and testing meter metrics, parameter histograms, and gradient histograms at the end of each training phase
